question: Which of our documents are doing the most compliance work?
answer:
I cannot answer which of your documents are doing the most compliance work without a specific scope. The `compliance_coverage` tool requires a specific regulatory address (like a Part or a Requirement ID) to generate a report on which operator sections are linked to which requirements.

If you can point me to a specific standard (e.g., "CIP-007-6") or a specific Part, I can run a report to show you the coverage distribution and identify which of your documents are mapped to the most requirements.
